title: Ten Seconds Left
setup: White opened with the f-pawn, has just developed a knight, and has never looked at the diagonal that opened on move one.
hint: The f-pawn left home on move one. Which of your pieces can reach the diagonal it opened, and with check?
explanation:
## The Idea

White's f-pawn left on move one and opened the e1–h4 diagonal, and nothing has closed it since.

{{Qh4+}} leaves White one answer, {{g3}}: the king cannot go to f2, and the g-pawn is the only thing that can block. Then Black mates in two either way, {{Bxg3+}} {{hxg3}} {{Qxg3#}}, or the queen first with {{Qxg3+}} {{hxg3}} {{Bxg3#}}.

When an opponent moves the f-pawn early, spend one second on a queen check at h4.
